name: Ichaloli! ~Toshishita no Kanojo to Ichaicha suru Nichijou~
original_name: いちゃロリっ!～年下の彼女といちゃいちゃする日常～
source:
Aika Yumesaki hangs out with you in your room every day.
You choose the play, and her body will gradually be awakened erotically...
And those changes open up new kinds of play.
As she realizes the pleasure of sexual acts, just what fate awaits her...
